signals.explanation: Setpoint PledgeCheck: collateral appears in more than one active facility
Servicer-system pull: 2 of 60 sampled 'eligible' loans are actually 60+ days late or no longer active
'Silverline Specialty Finance LLC' holds a lien on the borrower ('Prairie Distribution LLC': all receivables and chattel paper (loan collateral)) that the borrower never disclosed
Setpoint PledgeCheck: actual collections don't match what the borrower reported
7 loans flagged 'deferred' with no disclosed deferment programme
Debt reported to Wells Fargo omits 1 secured lender(s) found in public lien filings

steps.title: Pause new advances against the affected collateral
steps.draft:
INTERNAL ACTION MEMO — Pause new advances against the affected collateral
Case: B0116 · Finding: the same collateral is pledged to more than one lender (high confidence)
Action: Place a hold on further advances against the collateral named in the evidence until uniqueness is confirmed.
Based on:
  - Setpoint PledgeCheck: collateral appears in more than one active facility [ref S1-B0116-PLEDGECHECK_UNIQUENESS_FAIL-29c3cdd0]
  - 'Silverline Specialty Finance LLC' holds a lien on the borrower ('Prairie Distribution LLC': all receivables and chattel paper (loan collateral)) that the borrower never disclosed [ref S5-B0116-COMPETING_LIEN-17e2b85d]
  - Debt reported to Wells Fargo omits 1 secured lender(s) found in public lien filings [ref S7-B0116-DEBT_GAP-51323773]

Due: 2026-09-12 · Requires approval before it is carried out.

steps.title: Ask the other secured party for a payoff / estoppel letter
steps.draft:
DRAFT LETTER — Ask the other secured party for a payoff / estoppel letter
To: Silverline Specialty Finance LLC (secured party of record)
Re: Facility monitoring — request for information (B0116)

As part of our routine monitoring of the facility, we have identified items we need to reconcile:
  - Setpoint PledgeCheck: collateral appears in more than one active facility [ref S1-B0116-PLEDGECHECK_UNIQUENESS_FAIL-29c3cdd0]
  - 'Silverline Specialty Finance LLC' holds a lien on the borrower ('Prairie Distribution LLC': all receivables and chattel paper (loan collateral)) that the borrower never disclosed [ref S5-B0116-COMPETING_LIEN-17e2b85d]
  - Debt reported to Wells Fargo omits 1 secured lender(s) found in public lien filings [ref S7-B0116-DEBT_GAP-51323773]

Please provide a payoff or estoppel letter stating the collateral you claim, the amount outstanding, and whether any of it overlaps the listed assets by 2026-09-16.

This letter requests information to reconcile our records. It does not allege wrongdoing by any party.

[Credit officer], Wells Fargo

steps.title: Expand the source-system sample on the affected pool
steps.draft:
INTERNAL ACTION MEMO — Expand the source-system sample on the affected pool
Case: B0116 · Finding: bad loans are being reported as good ones (high confidence)
Action: Increase the servicer-system sample to at least 200 loans and compare status field by field.
Based on:
  - Servicer-system pull: 2 of 60 sampled 'eligible' loans are actually 60+ days late or no longer active [ref S2-B0116-SOURCE_MISMATCH-d9a8ecbf]
  - Setpoint PledgeCheck: actual collections don't match what the borrower reported [ref S1-B0116-PLEDGECHECK_COMPLETENESS_FAIL-240f2fb8]
  - 7 loans flagged 'deferred' with no disclosed deferment programme [ref S2-B0116-DEFERMENT_WITHOUT_PROGRAM-4f7a2bea]
  - 4.1% of loans reported current had no payment arrive (28 of 687) [ref S2-B0116-CURRENT_WITHOUT_PAYMENT-0ac124ef]

Due: 2026-09-14 · Requires approval before it is carried out.
